senses.gloss: m.(b. h. צֹעֵר; צָעַר)boy, servant. Mekh. Mishp. s. 16 (ref. to Ex. XXII, 11) מעמו להוציא את הצ׳ ‘from with him’, this excludes the shepherd boy from responsibility; [another vers. להביא את הצ׳ this includes the shepherd’s responsibility for the shepherd boy;] Yalk. Ex. 346 הצועד (corr. acc.).—Pl. צוֹעֲרִים, constr. צוֹעֲרֵי.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:6">Arakh. II, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Arakhin 2:2">Tosef. ib. II, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00656"><he>צָעִיר</he></cite>.
